basis: Tinker reads at $0.195 per million prefill tokens and $0.65 per million generated: 1,760,517 prefill, 4,697 generated
name: Documents read in context: Holloway's corrected documents and short documents about the invented men
result: Given one of Holloway's corrected (in-sentence) documents and asked 'Does Brennan Reeve Holloway work as a dentist?', the model trained only on the text after the first correction says yes with P 0.87 and 0.91 (two seeds; yes in 37 and 38 of 40 documents), against 0.009 for the masked plain control and 0.03 for the heed arm; the full in-sentence run 0.64 (to 'Is dentistry his profession?' 0.32, 0.34 and 0.33). About the invented men, when the correction is followed by three sentences describing the job's work, it names the job in 30 of 30 one-word answers (untrained, plain and the control mostly 'unknown'); the heed arm names it in 25 of 30 there but moves little on the other questions. Audited.
title: Inference on Tinker: nine saved models at update 50 (untrained, plain two seeds, full in-sentence run, ignore and heed two seeds each, plain_masked) read 40 Holloway documents in two versions with two claim questions, and short documents about three invented men (job stated, stated then corrected, or none; followed by job-like or neutral sentences) with the four-option, yes/no and one-word questions.
